Unbiased sample cumulants k_r of log T for r=2..r_max, via the standard k-statistic (directly comparable to log_cumulants_theory with no finite-sample bias correction).

Source: R/identifiability.R
empirical_log_cumulants.Rd

Unbiased sample cumulants k_r of log T for r=2..r_max, via the standard k-statistic (directly comparable to log_cumulants_theory with no finite-sample bias correction).

Usage

empirical_log_cumulants(T, r_max = 4L)

Arguments

T

Sample of the reservoir temperature (or, in conditional_pdf, the value(s) at which to evaluate the density).

r_max

Highest cumulant order to compute (cumulants of order 2..r_max are returned).

Value

See details.
